name: v0.4.2
author: maya
body:
## Fixes

- Return 400 for malformed percent escapes in route params ([#32](https://github.com/maya/tinyhttp/pull/32), fixes #31). Valid encoded params continue to decode.
- Retain response headers when answering HEAD requests ([#30](https://github.com/maya/tinyhttp/pull/30)).

Notes drafted from merged changes and reviewed by Maya.

```sh
bun add tinyhttp@0.4.2
```

name: v0.4.0
author: maya
body:
## Added

- Size-limited JSON body middleware, with streamed-byte accounting (#28).
- Middleware order, safe logging, and bounded input examples (#26).

The default JSON limit is 1 MiB and can be set per application.

name: v0.3.0
author: cora
body:
## Added

- Stream Web Responses through node:http without buffering the complete body (#24).

## Fixed

- Decode plus signs as spaces in form-style query values, while preserving encoded literal plus signs (#9).

name: v0.2.0
author: maya
body:
## Routing

- Prefer static segments over named parameters, regardless of registration order (#7, fixes #8).

Equal-specificity routes retain their registration order.
